titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Pearl Passes Through Solomon’s Ancestors (ch. 68, part 1 of 2)
part: ch. 68, part 1 of 2 — The Pearl Passes Through Solomon’s Ancestors
about: The angel continues to Solomon: the saviour’s line is a pearl, created in Adam’s womb before Eve and passed down from Seth through Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Judah, Jesse, David and Solomon, each time bypassing the proud or erring firstborn for the humble, until it comes to Jeroboam’s line so that the saviour can be crucified and descend to Sheol. All who carried the pearl, men and women, are promised salvation.

sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፷፰ is 60 + 8 (Ethiopic numerals, tens then ones; here no ወ- ‘and’ is written between them, unlike ፷ወ፯ in ch. 67). በእንተ ‘concerning’ takes a noun. መድኀኒትነ is መድኀኒት ‘salvation, saviour’ + -ነ ‘our’ (a suffix, not a construct); ‘our saviour Mary’, a title for Mary, is also possible (?). The speaker is presumably the angel of the Lord of ch. 67, still addressing Solomon (?).

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ይኩንከ ፡ ትእምርተ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይመጽእ ፡ መድኅን ፡ እምዘርእከ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ያድኅንከ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አበዊከ ፡ ወዘርእከ ፡ እምድኅሬከ ፡ በምጽአቱ ።
sentences.l: And-again let-be-to-you sign that he-may-come saviour from-your-seed, and-that he-may-save-you with your-fathers and-your-seed from-after-you at-his-coming.
sentences.i: And again, let it be a sign to you that a saviour will come from your seed, and that he will save you, together with your fathers and your seed after you, at his coming.
sentences.n: ወካዕበ = ወ- ‘and’ + ካዕበ ‘again’. ይኩንከ = ይኩን (3ms subjunctive of ኮነ ‘be’, used as a jussive ‘let it be’) + -ከ ‘to you’; ትእምርተ ‘sign’ is the accusative predicate. ከመ + ይመጽእ: ከመ ‘that’ takes the subjunctive (3ms subjunctive of መጽአ ‘come’), and ወከመ ያድኅንከ continues it: ያድኅን (3ms subjunctive) is the causative (አ-stem) of ድኅነ ‘be safe’, i.e. ‘save’, + -ከ ‘you’. ወዘርእከ ‘and your seed’ is joined to the group that is saved (reading from context (?)). እምድኅሬከ = እም- ‘from’ + ድኅሬ ‘after’ + -ከ. በምጽአቱ = በ- ‘at, in’ + ምጽአት ‘coming’ + -ሁ ‘his’.

sentences.t: ተፈጥረት ፡ መደኀኒትክሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከርሠ ፡ አዳም ፡ ከመ ፡ ዕንቈ ፡ ባሕርይ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ሔዋን ፤
sentences.l: Was-created your-salvation in womb-of Adam like jewel-of pearl from-before Eve;
sentences.i: Your salvation was created in Adam’s womb, like a pearl-stone, before Eve;
sentences.n: ተፈጥረት is the passive (tä-stem) of ፈጠረ ‘create’, 3fs perfect, agreeing with the feminine noun መድኀኒት (spelled መደኀኒትክሙ here, with -ክሙ ‘your’, plural). ከርሠ is the construct of ከርሥ ‘womb, belly’; ዕንቈ is the construct of ዕንቍ ‘stone, gem’, so ዕንቈ ባሕርይ ‘jewel-of pearl’, a pearl-stone (house: ዕንቍ ‘jewel, precious stone’, ባሕርይ ‘pearl’). ‘The pearl’ (ባሕርይ) is the image running through the whole chapter for the line of descent that carries the future saviour. እምቅድመ = እም- ‘from’ + ቅድመ ‘before, prior to’; ‘from before’ is idiomatically ‘before’.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ፈጠራ ፡ ለሔዋን ፡ እምዐፅመ ፡ ገቦሁ ፡ ለአዳም ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ብዝኁ ፡ እምከርሠ ፡ አዳም ፡ ኢወፅአት ፡ ኀበ ፡ ቀየን ፡ ወአቤል ፡ አላ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሣልስ ፡ ወፅአት ፡ እምከርሠ ፡ አዳም ፡ ወገብአት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከርሡ ፡ ለሴት ፤
sentences.l: And-when he-created-her Eve from-bone-of his-side, Adam’s, and-he-said-to-them ‘Be-many’, from-womb-of Adam not-went-out-she to Cain and-Abel but to third she-went-out from-womb-of Adam and-she-returned into his-womb, Seth’s;
sentences.i: When he created Eve from the bone of Adam’s side and said to them, “Increase,” the pearl did not go out from Adam’s womb to Cain and Abel; it went out from Adam’s womb to the third son, and returned into the womb of Seth;
sentences.n: ፈጠራ = ፈጠረ ‘created’ + -ኣ ‘her’, with ለሔዋን repeating the object; likewise ገቦሁ ለአዳም ‘his side, (that) of Adam’ and ከርሡ ለሴት ‘his womb, (that) of Seth’ — a common Geʿez way to express ‘of’ with a pronoun placed first. ወይቤሎሙ = ወ- + ይቤ ‘he said’ + -ሎሙ ‘to them’. ብዝኁ is the 2mp imperative of በዝኀ ‘be many’, echoing Genesis 1:28 (‘be fruitful and multiply’); I take the quotation to end there and what follows to be a new statement (?). ወፅአት ‘it went out’ and ገብአት ‘it returned’ (house sense; ‘came back into’ the line of Seth) are 3fs perfects with ባሕርይ understood as the subject. ኀበ ‘to, toward’; ሣልስ ‘third’ is Seth (Genesis 4:25), after Cain and Abel.

sentences.t: ወእምኔሁ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ተሐውር ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ባሕርይ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እለ ፡ ኮኑ ፡ በኵረ ፡ በጽሐት ፡ እስከ ፡ አብርሃም ፤
sentences.l: And-from-him while she-goes she, the-pearl, to those who were firstborn she-arrived as-far-as Abraham;
sentences.i: And from him, while the pearl went on to those who were firstborn, it reached as far as Abraham;
sentences.n: እንዘ + imperfect (ተሐውር, 3fs of ሖረ ‘go’) = ‘while going’; ይእቲ ‘she’ restates the subject, ባሕርይ ‘the pearl’. እለ ኮኑ በኵረ = ‘those who were (as) firstborn’ (በኵረ accusative). በጽሐት ‘it reached’ (3fs perfect). The pattern that runs through the next units is set here: the pearl goes to each generation in turn but passes over some firstborn sons and rests with a worthier one.

sentences.t: ወእምነ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ኢወፅአት ፡ ውስተ ፡ በኵሩ ፡ ይስማዔል ፡ አላ ፡ ጸንሐት ፡ ወቦአት ፡ ኀበ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ ንጹሕ ፤
sentences.l: And-from Abraham not-went-out-she into his-firstborn Ishmael but she-waited and-entered to Isaac, pure;
sentences.i: And from Abraham it did not go out to his firstborn, Ishmael. It waited, and entered Isaac, the pure one;
sentences.n: ወእምነ = ወ- + እም ‘from’ (here with -ነ). ጸንሐት ‘she waited, remained’ (3fs perfect). ቦአት ‘she entered’; ኀበ ‘to’. ንጹሕ ‘pure, clean’ is an adjective in apposition to Isaac. Ishmael is passed over (Genesis 16, 21).

sentences.t: ወእምይስሐቅኒ ፡ ኢሖረት ፡ ኀበ ፡ በኵር ፡ ዕቡይ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ አላ ፡ ቦአት ፡ ኀበ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ትሑት ፤
sentences.l: And-from-Isaac-also not-went-she to firstborn, proud, Esau, but entered-she to Jacob, humble;
sentences.i: From Isaac, too, it did not go to the firstborn, proud Esau, but entered Jacob, the humble;
sentences.n: -ኒ on ወእምይስሐቅኒ is an enclitic, ‘and … also’. ዕቡይ ‘proud’ and ትሑት ‘humble’ are adjectives set against each other; the chapter sorts the ancestors by the moral pair proud/humble. Esau and Jacob: Genesis 25–27.

sentences.t: ወእምያዕቆብ ፡ ኢቦአት ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ በኵሩ ፡ ስሑት ፡ አላ ፡ ቦአት ፡ ኀበ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ የዋህ ፤
sentences.l: And-from-Jacob not-entered-she to Reuben, his-firstborn, erring, but entered-she to Judah, gentle;
sentences.i: From Jacob it did not enter Reuben, his firstborn, the erring one, but entered Judah, the gentle;
sentences.n: ኢቦአት = ኢ- ‘not’ + ቦአት ‘she entered’. በኵሩ ‘his firstborn’ (በኵር + -ሁ). ስሑት ‘erring, gone astray’ (from the root s-ḥ-t ‘err’, verb ሰሐተ by my reading (?); compare ስሕተት ‘error’); Reuben’s offence is in Genesis 35:22 and 49:4. የዋህ ‘gentle, simple’. Judah receives the line (Genesis 49:8–12).

sentences.t: ወእምይሁዳኒ ፡ ኢወፅአት ፡ እስከ ፡ ይትወለዲ ፡ ፬ ፡ መአብሳን ፡ አላ ፡ ቦአት ፡ ኀበ ፡ ፋሬስ ፡ መስተዐግስ ፤
sentences.l: And-from-Judah-also not-went-out-she until are-born 4 sinners(?), but entered-she to Perez, patient;
sentences.i: From Judah, too, it did not go out until four sinners (?) were born, but entered Perez, the patient;
sentences.n: ይትወለዲ looks like ይትወለዱ, 3mp subjunctive (same form as the imperfect) of the tä-stem of ወለደ ‘beget’ (‘are born’), after እስከ, with the ending written -ዲ; the same ending recurs in ኢክሕዲ below, so it is a feature of this text rather than a slip (?). መአብሳን is a plural I cannot parse with certainty; it may belong with አበሰ ‘sin’ (ሶበ አነ አበስኩ ‘when I sinned’, ch. 67), so ‘sinners’ (?), which suits the contrast with the worthy son that follows; ‘unfit, unworthy’ would be a weaker guess (?). The count ፬ is ‘four’. መስተዐግስ ‘patient, enduring’ is a participle (መስተ- prefix) of ተዐገሠ ‘endure’. Perez: Genesis 38:29 and 46:12.

sentences.t: ወእምኔሁ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ባሕርይ ፡ ሖረት ፡ ኀበ ፡ በኵር ፡ እስከነ ፡ በጽሐት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከርሠ ፡ እሴይ ፡ አበ ፡ አቡከ ፤
sentences.l: And-from-him she, the-pearl, went to firstborn until she-arrived into womb-of Jesse, father-of your-father;
sentences.i: From him the pearl went on to the firstborn until it reached the womb of Jesse, the father of your father;
sentences.n: ይእቲ ባሕርይ ‘she, the pearl’ — ይእቲ restates the subject, as in ወእምኔሁ እንዘ ተሐውር ይእቲ ባሕርይ above (it could also be read ‘that pearl’). ሖረት ‘she went’. እስከነ is an unclear form of እስከ ‘until’, with a final -ነ I cannot account for (?). አበ አቡከ: አበ is the construct of አብ ‘father’; አቡከ is አብ + -ከ ‘your’ (the form አቡ- before suffixes) — ‘father-of your-father’, i.e. Jesse, David’s father (1 Samuel 16).

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ጸንሐት ፡ እስከ ፡ ይትወለዲ ፡ ፮ ፡ ህርቡዳን ፡ ወእምዝ ፡ ቦአት ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሳብዓይ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ አቡከ ፡ የዋህ ፡ ወትሑት ፡ እስመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ይጸልእ ፡ ዕቡያነ ፡ ወዝኁራነ ፡ ወያፈቅር ፡ የዋሃነ ፡ ወትሑታነ ፤
sentences.l: And-then she-waited until are-born 6 perverse-ones (?), and-then entered-she to seventh, David your-father, gentle and-humble, for the-Lord hates proud-ones and-haughty-ones (?) and-loves gentle-ones and-humble-ones;
sentences.i: Then it waited until six perverse ones (?) had been born, and then it entered the seventh, David your father, gentle and humble. For the Lord hates the proud and the haughty (?), and loves the gentle and the humble;
sentences.n: ወእምዝ ‘and then’. ህርቡዳን is a plural I cannot identify; ‘perverse’ is a guess from context (?). David as the seventh son of Jesse follows 1 Chronicles 2:13–15 (1 Samuel 16 has eight sons). ዕቡያነ, ዝኁራነ, የዋሃነ, ትሑታነ are accusative plurals in -ነ, objects of ይጸልእ ‘he hates’ and ያፈቅር ‘he loves’ (3ms imperfect). ዝኁራነ ‘haughty’ is likewise uncertain (?), taken as the partner of ‘proud’. The maxim echoes Proverbs 3:34 (cited in James 4:6) and Psalm 138:6.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ጸንሐት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሐቌ ፡ አቡከ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይትወለዲ ፡ ፭ ፡ ስሑታን ፡ ወአብዳን ፡ ወቦአት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሐቌ ፡ ዚአከ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ጥበብከ ፡ ወልቡናከ ።
sentences.l: And-then she-waited in loins-of your-father until are-born 5 erring-ones and-fools, and-entered-she into loins yours(-own) because-of your-wisdom and-your-understanding.
sentences.i: Then it waited in your father’s loins until five erring ones and fools had been born, and it entered your own loins because of your wisdom and understanding.
sentences.n: ሐቌ ‘loins’. ስሑታን ‘erring ones’ and አብዳን ‘fools’ are plurals of ስሑት and አብድ. ዚአከ ‘your own’ (ዚአ + -ከ) is emphatic: this is the turn from David to Solomon. ጥበብከ and ልቡናከ are nouns with -ከ ‘your’; the second has ወ- ‘and’. Solomon’s wisdom: 1 Kings 3:12.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ጸንሐት ፡ ባሕርይ ፡ ወኢሖረት ፡ ኀበ ፡ በኵርከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሠናያን ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ሀገሩ ፡ እመ ፡ ኢክሕድዎ ፡ ወእመ ፡ ኢሰቀልዎ ፡ ከመ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ሕዝብከ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይሬእዩ ፡ ዘይገብር ፡ ተኣምረ ፡ ዘይትወለድ ፡ እምባሕርይ ፡ እሙንቱሰ ፡ የአምኑ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ በሰሚዐ ፡ ዜናሁ ፤
sentences.l: And-then she-waited, the-pearl, and-not-went to your-firstborn, for good they, men-of his-city, if-not they-denied-him and-if-not they-crucified-him like Israel your-people when they-see one-who works wonder, one-who is-born from-the-pearl; they-indeed will-believe in-him on-hearing his-report;
sentences.i: Then the pearl waited and did not go to your firstborn, for the men of his city are good: if they did not deny him and did not crucify him, like Israel your people (?), when they see the one who works wonders, who is born of the pearl, they, for their part, will believe in him on hearing the report of him;
sentences.n: The sense is compressed and I have read it as: the pearl did not go to Solomon’s firstborn because his people are good and would believe, whereas the saviour must be crucified, which the next lines draw out (?). እመ ኢክሕድዎ ‘if they did not deny him’ and እመ ኢሰቀልዎ ‘if they did not crucify him’ are 3mp perfects with -ኦ ‘him’ after እመ ‘if’ + ኢ- ‘not’; I read them as a protasis (‘if they did not deny … or crucify …’) whose apodosis is እሙንቱሰ የአምኑ ‘they will believe’ (?). ሀገሩ ‘his city’ (whose city is not stated (?)). ይሬእዩ is the 3mp imperfect of ርእየ ‘see’. ክሕደ ‘deny’ and ሰቀለ ‘crucify’ have the object -ኦ ‘him’ (here -ዎ). ዘይገብር ተኣምረ = ዘ- ‘who’ + 3ms imperfect ‘does, works’ + ተኣምረ ‘wonder, sign’ (accusative). ዘይትወለድ ‘who is born’ (tä-stem). እሙንቱሰ ‘they indeed’ (-ሰ marks contrast). በሰሚዐ = በ- ‘by’ + the infinitive ሰሚዐ ‘hearing’; ዜናሁ ‘his report’. Compare Romans 10:17 on faith from hearing.

sentences.t: ወኀበ ፡ ዘይንእስኒ ፡ ወልድከ ፡ አድራሚ ፡ ኢሖረት ፡ እስመ ፡ እሙን ፡ ቱ ፡ ሰናያን ፡ እመ ፡ ኢሰቀልዎ ፡ ወእመ ፡ ኢክሕዲ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ርእዩ ፡ ዘይገብር ፡ ተኣምረ ፡ ወመንክረ ፡ ዘይትወለድ ፡ እምባሕርይ ፡ ወበደኃሪ ፡ የአምኑ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ በአርድእቱ ።
sentences.l: And-to the-one-who-is-young-also, your-son Adrami (?), not-went-she, for they-are (?), good, if-not they-crucified-him and-if-not they-denied when they-saw one-who works wonder and-marvel, one-who is-born from-the-pearl, and-in-the-end they-believe in-him through-his-disciples.
sentences.i: Nor did it go to the younger one, your son Adrami (?), since they are good: if they did not crucify him and did not deny him when they saw the one who works wonders and marvels, who is born of the pearl, then in the end they will believe in him through his disciples.
sentences.n: ዘይንእስኒ = ዘ- ‘the one who’ + ይንእስ ‘is young’ + -ኒ ‘also’, so ‘the younger one’. አድራሚ is unexplained: a name, or a corrupt word; I leave it as ‘Adrami’ (?). እሙን ፡ ቱ is divided by a wordspace in the printed text; I read it as እሙንቱ ‘they are’ (?), as in the previous unit, and so do not render ‘faithful’; read as two words (እሙን ‘faithful’ + a stray ቱ) the sense would add ‘faithful and good’ (?). ኢሰቀልዎ is a 3mp perfect + -ኦ ‘him’. ኢክሕዲ again has the -ዲ ending for 3mp (see the note on ይትወለዲ). ርእዩ ‘they saw’ (3mp perfect of ርእየ). መንክር ‘marvel’. ወበደኃሪ ‘and afterward’. የአምኑ ቦቱ ‘they will believe in him’ (3mp imperfect of አምነ, with በ- + -ቱ ‘in him’). በአርድእቱ ‘through his disciples’ (አርድእት, plural of ረድእ ‘disciple’, + -ሁ).

sentences.t: አላ ፡ ባሕቱ ፡ ወፅአት ፡ ባሕርይ ፡ እምከርሥከ ፡ እንተ ፡ ትከውን ፡ መድኀኒተክሙ ፡ ወቦአት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከርሠ ፡ ኢዮርብዓም ፡ ወልድከ ፡ በእንተ ፡ እከዮሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ሕዝብከ ፡ እስመ ፡ በክሕደቶሙ ፡ ወበ ፡ እከዮሙ ፡ ይሰቅልዎ ፤
sentences.l: But nevertheless went-out-she the-pearl from-your-womb, which will-be your-salvation, and-entered-she into womb-of Jeroboam your-son because-of their-evil to-Israel your-people, for through-their-denial and-through their-evil they-will-crucify-him;
sentences.i: But nevertheless the pearl went out from your womb, which will be your salvation, and entered the womb of Jeroboam your son, because of the evil of Israel your people; for through their denial and their evil they will crucify him;
sentences.n: አላ ባሕቱ ‘but nevertheless’. እንተ is the feminine relative ‘which’, with ትከውን ‘she will be’ (3fs imperfect of ኮነ) and the predicate መድኀኒተክሙ ‘your salvation’ (accusative, -ክሙ ‘your’ plural). The text names Jeroboam as Solomon’s son here, where 1 Kings 12 has Rehoboam; I keep the name as written. እከዮሙ = እከይ ‘evil’ + -ሆሙ ‘their’; ለእስራኤል marks the possessor (‘the evil of Israel’). ወበ ፡ እከዮሙ has a stray wordspace after በ-; read ወበእከዮሙ ‘and through their evil’. ክሕደቶሙ ‘their denial’. ይሰቅልዎ ‘they will crucify him’ (3mp imperfect + -ኦ).

sentences.t: ወሶበሰ ፡ ኢተሰቅለ ፡ እመ ፡ ኢኮነ ፡ መድኀኒትክሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ ይሰቀል ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ወይትነሣእ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ሙስና ፡ ወበእንተዝ ፡ ይወርድ ፡ ኀቤከሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሲኦል ፡ ወይነሥት ፡ አረፋቲሃ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያድኅንክሙ ፡ ወያውፅእክሙ ፡ ወይምሐርክሙ ፡ ለኵልክሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-if-indeed not-he-were-crucified, if not-he-were your-salvation, for he-is-crucified without sin and-rises without corruption, and-on-this-account he-descends to-you into Sheol and-tears-down its-walls (?) that he-may-save-you and-bring-you-out and-have-mercy-on-you, for-all-of-you;
sentences.i: And if he were not crucified, he would not be your salvation, for he is crucified without sin and rises without corruption; and on this account he goes down to you into Sheol, and tears down its walls (?), to save you, to bring you out, and to have mercy on all of you;
sentences.n: ወሶበሰ ‘and if, indeed’ (ሶበ ‘when, if’ + -ሰ). ኢተሰቅለ is the passive (tä-stem) of ሰቀለ ‘crucify’; ኢኮነ (3ms perfect) ‘he would not be’, the second እመ ‘if’ leading the second half of the sentence (?). ይሰቀል (passive of ሰቀለ) and ይትነሣእ (tä-stem of ንሥአ) are 3ms imperfects (‘is crucified’, ‘rises’). ዘእንበለ ‘without’ takes a noun: ኀጢአት ‘sin’, ሙስና ‘corruption’ (compare Acts 2:27, Psalm 16:10). ወበእንተዝ ‘and on this account’. ይወርድ ‘he descends’; ኀቤከሙ = ኀበ (stem ኀቤ-) + -ከሙ ‘to you (pl.)’; ሲኦል ‘Sheol, the place of the dead’, the descent to the dead (compare 1 Peter 3:19). ይነሥት ‘he tears down’; አረፋቲሃ is plural of አረፍት plus -ሃ ‘its’, ‘walls’ being a guess (?). ያድኅንክሙ, ያውፅእክሙ, ይምሐርክሙ are 3ms subjunctives with -ክሙ ‘you’, after ከመ ‘that’; ለኵልክሙ ‘to all of you’ stresses the object.

sentences.t: እለ ፡ ተጸውረት ፡ ባሕርይ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከርሥክሙ ፡ ትድኅኑ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አንስቲያክሙ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘይትሀጐል ፡ እምኔክሙ ፡ እምአቡከ ፡ አዳም ፡ እስከ ፡ ዘይመጽእ ፡ ዘመድከ ፡ ኤያቄም ፡ ወእምሔዋን ፡ እምከ ፡ ብእሲቱ ፡ ለአዳም ፡ እስከ ፡ ኖኅ ፡ ወብእሲቱ ፡ ተርሚዛ ፡ እስከ ፡ ታራ ፡ ወብእሲቱ ፡ አሚንያ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ወብእሲቱ ፡ ሳራ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ ወብእሲቱ ፡ ርብቃ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ወብእሲቱ ፡ ልያ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ወመርዓቱ ፡ ትዕማር ፡ ወእስከ ፡ አቡከ ፡ ወብእሲቱ ፡ ቤርሳቤሕ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ለሊከ ፡ ወተርባና ፡ ብእሲትከ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ኢዮርብዓም ፡ ወልድከ ፡ ወአሚሳ ፡ ብእሲቱ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ኢዮአቄም ፡ ዘይመጽእ ፡ ዘመድከ ፡ ወብእሲቱ ፡ ሐና ፤
sentences.l: Those-who was-carried the-pearl in your-wombs you-will-be-saved with your-wives, and-there-is-not one-who is-lost from-you, from-your-father Adam until he-who-comes, your-kinsman Joachim, and-from-Eve, your-mother, his-wife, Adam’s, until Noah and-his-wife Termiza, until Terah and-his-wife Aminya, and-until Abraham and-his-wife Sarah, and-until Isaac and-his-wife Rebecca, and-until Jacob and-his-wife Leah, and-until Judah and-his-bride Tamar, and-until your-father and-his-wife Bathsheba, and-until yourself and-Terbana your-wife, and-until Jeroboam your-son and-Amisa his-wife, and-until Joachim, who comes, your-kinsman, and-his-wife Hannah;
sentences.i: You in whose wombs the pearl was carried will be saved, with your wives, and none of you will be lost: from your father Adam to your kinsman Joachim, who is yet to come; and from Eve, your mother, the wife of Adam, to Noah and his wife Termiza; to Terah and his wife Aminya; to Abraham and his wife Sarah; to Isaac and his wife Rebecca; to Jacob and his wife Leah; to Judah and his daughter-in-law Tamar; to your father and his wife Bathsheba; to you and your wife Terbana; to Jeroboam your son and his wife Amisa; and to Joachim, your kinsman who is to come, and his wife Hannah;
sentences.n: This unit is a single long list, over the usual length, but it contains no ፤ at which to cut it. እለ ተጸውረት ባሕርይ ‘those in whom the pearl was carried’ (ተጸውረት is the passive of ጾረ ‘carry, bear’, 3fs, with ባሕርይ as subject); ትድኅኑ is 2mp imperfect (of ድኅነ ‘be safe’) (‘you will be saved’); ወአልቦ ዘይትሀጐል ‘and there is none who is lost’ (ሀጐለ ‘perish’, tä-stem). አንስቲያክሙ ‘your wives’ (plural of ብእሲት). እስከ ‘as far as, until’ marks each step of the list, with ወ- ‘and’ on the later ones. ዘይመጽእ ‘who comes’ means ‘who is still to come’. ዘመድ ‘kinsman’; እምከ = እም ‘mother’ + -ከ. ብእሲቱ ‘his wife’, መርዓቱ ‘his bride, daughter-in-law’ (Genesis 38). Joachim is spelled two ways (ኤያቄም, ኢዮአቄም); in Christian tradition he and Hannah (Anna) are Mary’s parents, though this text does not say so. The wives Termiza, Aminya, Terbana and Amisa are not named in Genesis or Kings; I give the names as the Geʿez has them.

sentences.t: ኵልክሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ጾርክምዋ ፡ ለባሕርይ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘይትሀጐል ፡ እምኔክሙ ፡ እምተባዕትክሙ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ አንስቲያክሙ ፡ ኢትትሀጐሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ጾርክምዋ ፡ ለባሕርይ ።
sentences.l: All-of-you who carried-her, the-pearl, there-is-not one-who is-lost from-you, from your-males and-as-far-as your-women: not-will-you-be-lost, you-who carried-her, the-pearl.
sentences.i: All of you who carried the pearl: none of you will be lost, from your men to your women. You will not be lost, you who carried the pearl.
sentences.n: ኵልክሙ = ኵሉ ‘all’ + -ክሙ ‘of you’. ጾርክምዋ = ጾርክሙ ‘you carried’ (2mp perfect of ጾረ) + -ዋ ‘her’, with ለባሕርይ repeating the object, as in ፈጠራ ለሔዋን above. ተባዕትክሙ ‘your males’ (ተባዕት ‘male’ + -ክሙ), እስከ አንስቲያክሙ ‘right to your women’. ኢትትሀጐሉ is the 2mp imperfect, negated, of the tä-stem of ሀጐለ. The unit ends the part with the promise of salvation to every ancestor, men and women alike.
